line: Regulatory crackdowns dominate the wire this morning as Markets holds steady, with enforcement actions across exchanges and persistent outflow pressure on spot Bitcoin products.

wire_top3.line: US Treasury cut MEXC from US financial system over $16 billion in alleged illicit transactions linked to Iran, North Korea, and Russia.
